subject: Re: How to access 'resolved label-rejection-messages' in the Encord's review stage interface, for re-submitted tasks
text:
Hi Seif,

We're looking FW to the new functionality.
On the use-case justifying showing the review-messages for deleted objects:

1. On a DICOM annotation task there were 2 keypoint locations for the same lung lesion on 2 consecutive frames, alongside a polyline annotation for its diameter (in 1 of the frames).
Note there were a total of 9 keypoints/lung lesions annotated (1 repeated - easy to see as there were 9 keypoints but only 8 diameters).

2. in review stage, the (potential) extra keypoint was rejected, with the corresponding message, and re-opened to the annotation stage.

3. in annotation stage, the user resolved the message, removed the rejected keypoint and re-submitted.

4. Note the user could have selected either Keypoint in that lesion as the extra, so the rejected KeyPoint could have remained, and the nearby one rejected instead.
In this case the reviewer would have seen the rejected keypoint in the labels-to-review list (at the top of the left menu, in review stage).
However, 1 week later, another reviewer looked at the re-submitted case, and only saw the 8 keypoints and 8 diameters, which had already been approved, and
was uncertain about the reason for re-opening the case in the first place (given that the resolved messages are not shown).
Note that the previous reviewer might have also forgotten about their message.
If review-messages are only shown for present objects, it would not have solved this problem (the previous or a new reviewer would be uncertain about what was corrected).

Given that you keep deleted objects in your database perhaps this should be considered, to make the review process more efficient and reliable
(i.e. no time is wasted second-guessing the Encord review workflow).

Many thanks.
Best Wishes,
Mauro

Dr. Mauro Santos

Research Scientist

Optellum Ltd. www.optellum.com<http://www.optellum.com/>

E: mauro.santos@optellum.com

subject: Additional evidence required for 3rd party Information security and application security assessment for Geospatial Labelling Platform.

  *   Evidence related to shared roles and responsibilities within a cloud computing environment, allocated to identified parties, documented, communicated, and implemented at Cord.
